title: Paul's Sorrow for Israel, God's Sovereign Choice

questions.question: Paul says he has great sorrow and unceasing anguish in his heart. For he could wish that he himself were ____ from Christ for the sake of his brothers, his kinsmen according to the flesh.
questions.explanation: Romans 9:2-3 (ESV): "that I have great sorrow and unceasing anguish in my heart. For I could wish that I myself were accursed and cut off from Christ for the sake of my brothers, my kinsmen according to the flesh."

questions.question: Paul lists the privileges given to the Israelites. Which of the following is NOT listed in verses 4-5?
options: The adoption, the glory, the covenants
The giving of the law, the worship, and the promises
The patriarchs, and from their race is the Christ
The priesthood according to the order of Melchizedek
questions.correctAnswer: The priesthood according to the order of Melchizedek
questions.explanation: Romans 9:4-5 (ESV): "They are Israelites, and to them belong the adoption, the glory, the covenants, the giving of the law, the worship, and the promises. To them belong the patriarchs, and from their race, according to the flesh, is the Christ, who is God over all, blessed forever. Amen." The priesthood of Melchizedek is not listed here.

questions.question: Paul says it is not as though the word of God has failed, because "not all who are descended from Israel ____".
questions.explanation: Romans 9:6 (ESV): "But it is not as though the word of God has failed. For not all who are descended from Israel belong to Israel,"

questions.question: Nor are all children of Abraham because they are his offspring, but "Through ____ shall your offspring be named."
questions.explanation: Romans 9:7 (ESV): "and not all are children of Abraham because they are his offspring, but 'Through Isaac shall your offspring be named.'"

questions.question: This means that it is not the children of the flesh who are the children of God, but the children of the ____ are counted as offspring.
questions.explanation: Romans 9:8 (ESV): "This means that it is not the children of the flesh who are the children of God, but the children of the promise are counted as offspring."

questions.question: Regarding Rebekah's twins, before they were born or had done anything good or bad, what was she told by God?
options: "The younger will rule with a rod of iron."
"They shall strive together in your womb."
questions.explanation: Romans 9:11-12 (ESV): "though they were not yet born and had done nothing either good or bad... she was told, 'The older will serve the younger.'"

questions.question: As it is written concerning Esau and Jacob: "Jacob I loved, but Esau I ____."
questions.explanation: Romans 9:13 (ESV): "As it is written, 'Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.'"

questions.question: Is there injustice on God's part? By no means! For he says to Moses: "I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have ____ on whom I have ____."
questions.explanation: Romans 9:15 (ESV): "For he says to Moses, 'I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.'"

questions.question: So then it depends not on human will or exertion, but on God, who has ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 9:16 (ESV): "So then it depends not on human will or exertion, but on God, who has mercy."

questions.question: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh, "For this very purpose I have raised you up, that I might show my power in you, and that my name might be ____ in all the earth."
questions.explanation: Romans 9:17 (ESV): "For the Scripture says to Pharaoh, 'For this very purpose I have raised you up, that I might show my power in you, and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth.'"

questions.question: You will say to me then, "Why does he still find fault? For who can resist his will?" But who are you, O man, to answer back to God? Will what is molded say to its molder, ____?
options: "Why have you made me like this?"
"Give me life for my own purpose!"
"I can shape myself as I will!"
questions.correctAnswer: "Why have you made me like this?"
questions.explanation: Romans 9:19-20 (ESV): "...But who are you, O man, to answer back to God? Will what is molded say to its molder, 'Why have you made me like this?'"

questions.question: Has the potter no right over the clay, to make out of the same lump one vessel for honorable use and another for ____ use?
questions.explanation: Romans 9:21 (ESV): "Has the potter no right over the clay, to make out of the same lump one vessel for honorable use and another for dishonorable use?"

questions.question: What if God, desiring to show his wrath and to make known his power, has endured with much patience vessels of wrath prepared for ____?
questions.explanation: Romans 9:22 (ESV): "What if God, desiring to show his wrath and to make known his power, has endured with much patience vessels of wrath prepared for destruction,"

questions.question: Paul quotes Hosea regarding God's calling: "Those who were not my people I will call 'my people,' and her who was not beloved I will call ____."
questions.explanation: Romans 9:25 (ESV): "As indeed he says in Hosea, 'Those who were not my people I will call 'my people,' and her who was not beloved I will call 'beloved.''"

questions.question: Israel, who pursued a law that would lead to righteousness, did not succeed in reaching that law. Why? Because they did not pursue it by faith, but as if it were based on ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 9:31-32 (ESV): "but that Israel who pursued a law that would lead to righteousness did not succeed in reaching that law. Why? Because they did not pursue it by faith, but as if it were based on works."

key_verse_text: So then it depends not on human will or exertion, but on God, who has mercy.
